romfred_image_codes.subject_lists: 64 participants on the female product list, 28 on the male list; every participant matches one list on 100% of ItemIDs (only spelling variant: Messanger/Messenger Bag)
romfred_image_codes.evidence: female list aligns to ProductInformation file order 359/359; OSF b24dv allSubDataTable.xls (https://osf.io/p7qyn, the lab ID->image-code file for version 501) is strictly increasing in ProductInformation order on both lists (362 and 338 IDs, 0 descents), so arrays are built in that order
romfred_image_codes.rating_check: 58 order-assigned codes also rated online: r(romfred, shenhav1b/2) = .85 as assigned vs .68 with each shared-label group reversed; within most pairs of similar products ratings cannot discriminate (7 of 16 two-product groups favour the assignment)
romfred_image_codes.not_included: Rating2 (post-choice re-rating, version 504, 11,195 rows) was never imported; not added

notes: shenhav subject_id = migration 031 numbering (first appearance in Study*_2.csv), verified by exact value match; shenhav5b keeps its source ids; romfred = SubNum
romfred ratings = Rating1, x10 for versions 502/503 (migration 040)
collapsed shenhav items: the DB holds the FIRST source row of the group (source-file order), not a mean; romfred collapsed items hold the mean (migration 001 policy)
shenhav5b EC_0071 (mop with bucket) was shown twice to all 38 participants; DB kept the first rating, rebuild stores the mean (repo rule) -> 37 values change
